meta.title: Fractional and very large quantities do not lose precision
gaps: the plan has the buyer send PATCH /v1/bids/{{bidUuid}}, but the buyer's web-console session may not call PATCH /v1/bids/:id (bids#update is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
The setup creates only one line item, so the three specified quantities cannot be quoted.
The available vocabulary cannot set the requested quantities and prices for three lines.
No read-back field exposes line totals, bid totals, GST calculations, shown decimal places, or scientific-notation formatting.
API-BID-003 checks the submitted total against price multiplied by quantity at template precision, but does not check GST or the specific expected values.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
